fee_details:
- 1st Year Fee: Rs.2,500
- 2nd Year Onwards: Rs.2,500 + 15,000 Minimum spend if annual fee is not waived
reward_structure:
- Reward points are earned on spends across all categories.
- 4 points on spends of purchasing from merchants

benefits_features.Welcome benefits: As a welcome gift, the HDFC Business Regalia Credit Card also offers complimentary membership on Concierge Gold, where you get two complimentary drinks or one complimentary dish every time you visit a Gold partnered restaurant. To avail this benefit, you will have to spend Rs.25,000 on your card within the first three months of issue.
benefits_features.Cashback Program: With the HDFC Business Regalia Credit Card, you would enjoy a cashback of up to Rs.5,000 per statement cycle on eligible spends made in installments between this feature, government tax and other payments, namely hotel bookings, dining, and taxi booking. To avail this benefit, ensure to spend a minimum amount of Rs.20,000 on the card.
benefits_features.Reward Points Program:
The HDFC Business Regalia Credit Card offers a highly rewarding points earning program where you can enjoy the following privileges:
- Get 5000 reward points on spends every year on the card in its anniversary year
- Get 5000 reward points on every spend of Rs.1.5 Lakh every anniversary year
benefits_features.Airport Lounge programme: The HDFC Business Regalia Credit Card gives you preferential access to more than 1000 airport lounges across the globe through the Priority Pass Membership. Through this membership, you get numerous facilities like conference rooms, internet, restrooms, and phones. The Priority Pass Membership is available to primary cardholders as well as add-on cardholders. Briefly, the primary holder and the add-on cardholder can avail complimentary access to international lounges.
benefits_features.Contactless Payment Technology: You can use the card for contactless payments, thereby ensuring quick, secure and convenient payments at retail outlets. The card can also be used at merchant locations that accept contactless cards.
benefits_features.Dining Privileges: You can use the card to access exclusive offers at premium restaurants across the country.
benefits_features.Reward Programme: The points can be accumulated and can be used to book hotels and travel on spends. For every Rs.50 spent, you can earn one reward point. The points can be accumulated at InterMiles and will be used to reward and redeem on Snapdeal. Cardholders can also redeem up to 70% of the booking value through their reward points when booking hotels or flights. The reward points can also be converted into miles of major domestic as well as international airlines.
benefits_features.Travel Concierge Services: HDFC Business Regalia Credit Card Cardmembers can customize their entertainment and travel experience with the bank's Travel Concierge Assistance. The service is accessible 24/7 and can be reached on 1800-209-4004 or membersupport@travelwithprivia.com.
benefits_features.Fuel Benefits: The cardholder gets a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions at all fuel stations in India. The minimum transaction should be Rs.400. The maximum cashback of Rs.250 can be availed for every statement cycle.
benefits_features.Easy EMI Options: You can buy furniture, electronics or more at no extra cost with this card
benefits_features.Zero Lost Card Liability: If you lose your HDFC Bank Business Regalia credit card immediately report it to the HDFC Bank credit card customer care; otherwise, you are not liable for any fraudulent transactions made using your card.
benefits_features.Comprehensive Protection:
The card can be used to avail comprehensive insurance covers such as:
- Air Accidental Death: A cover of Rs.1 crore will protect your nominated kin in case of your demise in an accident.
- Emergency Overseas Hospitalisation: You can claim a protection worth Rs. 15 lakhs against medical emergencies that happen during your travels and you are outside your country of residence.
- Flight Delay: In case of delayed flights, a cover of up to Rs.25,000 is granted to the primary cardholder.
- Card Liability Cover: The primary and add-on cardholder get a cover of up to Rs.5 lakhs.
- Missing of Connecting International Flight: In this case, the primary and add-on cardholder can avail maximum cover of Rs.25,000.

how_tos.How to Apply for HDFC Business Regalia C:
Visit Business Regalia Credit Card at www.hdfcbank.com/personal/cards/credit/business-regalia
Click on the 'Apply Online' button
Fill the Credit Card Application Form with the required details
Click on 'Submit'
Once the application is successfully submitted, you will receive a call from HDFC representative, who would guide you through the further application process.

reward_point_benefits:
Each reward point is valued at 2 paise when you redeem them on HDFC website.
Reward points will not be accrued for fuel transactions.

fees_and_charges.Cash Advance Charges: Rs.500 or 2.5% of withdrawn amount whichever is higher
fees_and_charges.Over Limit Charges: 2.5% of over limit amount, subject to minimum Rs.500

miscellaneous:
Eligibility to Apply for HDFC Business Regalia Credit Card:
Applicant must be a self-employed businessman or professional
Should be in the age group of 21 to 65 years
Should have minimum net income more than 1.2 lakh in a year

faqs.1. Is the annual fee waiver applicable o: If the cardholder spends Rs.1.5 Lakh in one year, the next year's annual fee is waived.
faqs.2. What is the threshold of HDFC Reward: Reward points on HDFC Regalia Credit card are valid for two years from the date you accumulated it.
faqs.3. What is the exact value of one point: Each reward point is valued at 2 paise when you redeem them on HDFC website.
faqs.4. Do I get reward points for fuel trans: No, Reward points will not be accrued for fuel transactions.
